comparison.objective: Match two extinguisher types to their appropriate hazards; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Reading labels and carrying upright extinguishers versus fine mechanical tool use and response-based adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Wet-chemical and CO2 extinguishers placed at the specified risks versus two safe dynamic stops and retained setting. Exact placement thresholds and separate spec versions were not provided.
comparison.reason: This is semantic hazard matching and transport, not component commissioning.
